theme: Hanging groups off a ring to hit a target
title: Ring Substitution Pattern Under a Steric-Clash Correction and a Synthesis-Step Budget
strategies: trivial: leave every position unsubstituted (H everywhere) -- the checker's own reference construction

greedy: additive-model value-density knapsack -- rank substituents by (electronic + steric bonus)/synthesis-cost and pack the single best-density type into consecutive ring positions until the budget runs out, ignoring ring adjacency entirely

strong: exact cyclic dynamic program over (synthesis-steps used, previous position's substituent) that prices the ring-adjacency steric-clash correction exactly at every edge, so bulky substituents are spaced apart (or swapped for a milder alternative) whenever packing them adjacent would flip their combined contribution negative
invalid: out-of-range substituent ids at every position -> rejected before scoring
